select MENU_ID, COUNT(MENU_CONN_HIST_ID) AS MENU_COUNT, ROUND(COUNT(MENU_CONN_HIST_ID)/(select COUNT(MENU_CONN_HIST_ID) from JCMS_MENU_CON_HIST)*100,2) AS PERCENT from JCMS_MENU_CON_HIST where 1 = 1 and MENU_ID = #{menuId} and REG_DT >= CONCAT(#{startRegDt}, ' 00:00:00')
and REG_DT <= CONCAT(#{endRegDt}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY MENU_ID

select COUNT(HIST.MENU_CONN_HIST_ID) AS MENU_COUNT, DATE_FORMAT(HIST.REG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DT from JCMS_MENU_CON_HIST HIST, JCMS_MENU MENU where HIST.MENU_ID = MENU.MENU_ID and MENU.SITE_ID = #{siteId}
and HIST.REG_DT >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{startRegDt}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and HIST.REG_DT <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endRegDt}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and MENU.MENU_URL = 'main' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(HIST.REG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') order by DATE_FORMAT(HIST.REG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') DESC
